top_choice_rationale: P001 awards GLP-1 physiology to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. The chain from hormone physiology (secretion and actions of the active forms, proglucagon-derived peptide and receptor biology, identification and synthesis of the active truncated peptide) to incretin therapies is original and mechanistically understood. It has been confirmed by randomized outcome trials in diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal disease. The three-person allocation and a citation scoped to physiology that made the therapies possible are defensible, though Knudsen's exclusion and the Mojsov/Habener priority question are acknowledged costs. No award is clearly worse than this mature, high-impact achievement.
